name: 2-on-1 Fast Break
idea: When it’s two of you against one defender, make the defender pick one of you, then pass to the other.
why: One defender can’t guard two players. If they stop the dribbler, the runner is open. If they stay with the runner, the dribbler keeps going.
tryit: Play 2-on-1 at practice. The dribbler runs right at the defender, and the runner stays wide until the pass comes.

frames.say: *Fast break!* {1} and {2} race toward the hoop. Only {X1} got back to play defense.
{1} dribbles fast up the middle. {2} runs wide down the side. It’s 2 against 1!
{1} dribbles right at {X1}. {X1} has to stop {1}, or {1} will score!
{X1} is busy with {1}, so {1} passes to {2}.
{2} dribbles straight to the basket. {X1} tries to get back.
Layup! Two against one means somebody is always open.
